title: Meet the Computer
summary: Learn what a computer is and find computers around you.

steps.boltSpeech: Hi! I'm Bolt. Let's learn about computers!

content.text: A computer is a machine that helps us learn and play!

steps.boltSpeech: Tap each part to learn its name!

hotspots.label: Screen
hotspots.description: Shows pictures and words, like a TV.

hotspots.label: Keyboard
hotspots.description: Has buttons with letters and numbers.

hotspots.label: Mouse
hotspots.description: Helps you point and click on the screen.

options.label: Chair
options.image: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect x="30" y="20" width="40" height="40" fill="#8d6e63"/><rect x="30" y="60" width="40" height="10" fill="#795548"/><rect x="35" y="70" width="5" height="20" fill="#5d4037"/><rect x="60" y="70" width="5" height="20" fill="#5d4037"/></svg>

feedback.correct: Yes! A laptop is a computer you can carry.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. A chair is for sitting.

feedback.correct: Right! A tablet is a small computer with a touch screen.
feedback.incorrect: Oops. An apple is a fruit!
